evidence.title: GitHub - arseneHuot/openhive: Open-source Slack alternative you can self-host in minutes.

name: OpenHive
summary: Self-hosted open-source Slack alternative: channels, DMs, threads, reactions, file sharing and LiveKit calls.
description: A real-time team messaging app you self-host in minutes with your own Supabase instance. Public and private channels, DMs and group DMs, threaded replies, emoji reactions, mentions, file attachments, message editing, scheduling and bookmarks; optional video and audio calls via LiveKit with screen sharing; incoming/outgoing webhooks, bots, slash commands, an activity feed and full-text search with Cmd+K navigation. The setup wizard auto-provisions 23+ tables with row-level security; deploys to Vercel. MIT licensed.
contains: public/private channels, DMs and group DMs with presence
threaded replies, reactions, mentions, edits, scheduling and bookmarks
video and audio calls via LiveKit with screen sharing and incoming call banner
incoming/outgoing webhooks, bots and custom slash commands
activity feed, full-text search and Cmd+K quick navigation
setup wizard auto-provisions 23+ tables with Supabase RLS
workspace roles (owner, admin, member) with email invites
